Shocking food standards avoid at all cost.
Jul 2026 • Couples
Myself and my girlfriend visited.
We ordered 2 types of curry one lamb and one chicken. 
I dished the curry and rice onto our plates as then on first bite we realised the meat was cold and raw in the middle and the sauce was lukewarm at the most. 
We only realised this after we had put it on our plates.
I explained to the server and he took it away.
Minutes later he brought the same plates back I asked what this was ? He explained to me that he had put it in the microwave to re heat it.
This is extremely dangerous practice especially with chicken so I refused the food.
I was then given the full bill and the server insisted that we pay the full amount even though we had not eaten anything.

As an English couple in a foreign country we did not want and drama so we reluctantly paid the full bill.

But customers beware this place is shocking. 
Re heating uncooked meat like this will cause bacteria in your food. 
Eat here at your own risk...

Dalcheeni V
Dear Mr. Peter,

Thank you for sharing your concerns through your review. At the outset, please accept our sincere apologies for the unpleasant experience you had at Dalcheeni.

This is certainly not reflective of the high standards 
Dalcheeni strives to uphold.

We assure you that this was an atypical incident, and we regret the inconvenience caused.

Upon reviewing the situation with my server, we 
understand that the food was served promptly and lay on the table for more then 10min.

We sincerely regret that we were unable to reheat 
the dishes once they had been mixed and partially 
consumed on your plate.

Our service standards do not permit reheating food that has been 
served onto a guest's plate or consumed nor is it feasible to 
separate mixed food for reheating in our kitchen pans.

Generally, we reheat food in the original serving dishes rather than from a guest's plate.

We are truly sorry that your experience was not 
satisfactory, and we apologize for any 
disappointment this incident may have caused.

We assure you that your feedback will be addressed with the necessary measures to ensure improvements are made and to avoid such occurrences in the future.

We look forward to the opportunity of welcoming you back to our restaurant.

Warm Regards,
Rudolph Vivian D’Rozario(Shawn)
